issue_5.title: [Support] Self-serve `why is my transfer delayed` diagnostic flow
issue_5.body:
## Why
Many delay inquiries are repetitive (compliance hold, payout partner hours, incorrect receiver details). A guided self-serve flow deflects tickets and sets accurate expectations.

## Scope (Month 1)
- Design diagnostic tree from transfer status + known delay reason codes
- Implement in-app flow: select transfer → explain likely cause → next actions (wait window, edit details if allowed, contact support)
- Deep-link to live chat only when self-serve cannot resolve
- Cover top corridors / reason codes first; expand later

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] User can open the flow from transfer tracking without leaving the app
- [ ] Top reason codes produce plain-language explanations and next steps
- [ ] Escalation to chat/ticket preserves diagnostic context
- [ ] Deflection rate (flow compl

issue_4.title: [Support] Restore/expand in-app live chat for stuck transfers
issue_4.body:
## Why
Reviews repeatedly cite loss of human agents as a top frustration when transfers are stuck.

## Scope (Month 1)
- Inventory current chat entry points and where they were removed/gated
- Restore live chat for **stuck transfer** contexts (transaction detail, error states, tracking screen)
- Ensure chat transcript includes transfer MTCN / reference and corridor context
- Define hours, queue, and fallback (callback / ticket) when agents offline
- Log chat open → connect → resolution for instrumentation

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] From a delayed/stuck transfer screen, user can start live chat in ≤2 taps
- [ ] Agent sees transfer context without asking the user to re-type the reference
- [ ] Offline hours show clear fallback and expected response time
- [ ] Chat volume and connect succe

issue_8.title: [Instrumentation] Baseline funnel analytics for Phase 1 exit metrics
issue_8.body:
## Why
Needed to prove Phase 1 impact before Phase 2 investment. Watch **app-store rating** and **KYC time-to-approve** weekly; regression supersedes new feature work.

## Scope (Month 1)
Instrument and dashboard:
1. Onboarding drop-off by step
2. KYC time-to-approve (submit → approve/reject) + time-in-stage
3. Support ticket volume by category (incl. stuck transfer, KYC, login)
4. Auth failure rate and Android crash-free sessions (support Reliability issues)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Events defined, documented, and shipping in a release
- [ ] Dashboards live for the three primary Phase 1 funnels
- [ ] Weekly review ritual assigned (owner + channel)
- [ ] Alerting when KYC median TTA or rating trends regress

## Labels
Instrumentation · Phase 1 · Month 1

issue_6.title: [Reliability] Fix cross-border login and account-linking bugs
issue_6.body:
## Why
Explicitly called out in AU/EU Play Store reviews — login and account-linking failures block sending and amplify support volume.

## Scope (Month 1)
- Reproduce and catalog top login/account-linking failure modes (region switch, multi-device, SSO, phone/email mismatch)
- Fix P0/P1 defects; add regression tests for affected auth paths
- Improve error messaging (recoverable vs contact-support)
- Add structured logging / funnel events for auth failures (no PII in cleartext)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] P0/P1 known login/account-linking bugs fixed or have documented workarounds with owners
- [ ] Auth failure rate dashboard exists and is reviewed weekly
- [ ] Regression coverage for fixed paths
- [ ] Security review for any auth-flow changes

## Labels
Reliability · Phase 1 · Month 1
